_readme: The chronicle — the room's collective memory. Keys are stable; the engine calls line('key', {data}) and never contains the sentence itself. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from whatever the call site passes; a missing one renders as an ellipsis. Keep these numberless and occasional: the chronicle is the feed for things that happened to EVERYBODY, and the one-announcement rule (REVISION §0.4) says a stat change speaks only in a player's journal, never here.
career.retire.glorious: {name} retired — an all-time great of {arcade}, walking away on their own terms
career.retire.age: {name} played their last night at {arcade} after {nights} of them
career.retire.quiet: {name} quietly retired from the game after {nights} nights
circuit.regional.castWon: {champion} won {event}. The best in the country trains in YOUR room.
circuit.regional.castTop4: {name} made the final four at {event}. The country knows the arcade's name now.
circuit.qualifier.seatWon: {name} punched their ticket to the {season} Major at {event}.
circuit.qualifier.seatVoted: The crowd voted {name} into the {season} Major. Personality is access.
circuit.major.emptyChair: {name} QUALIFIED for {event} and stayed home. The seat was won weeks ago; the fare had to still be there today.
circuit.major.castWon: {champion} WON {event}. A world major. From this arcade.
circuit.major.watched: {event} came and went. {champion} took it. Nobody from {arcade} was in the room.
circuit.squad.called_off: {event} was called off — the scene couldn't field the crews.
circuit.squad.castWon: TEAM {arcadeUpper} WON THE SQUAD SHOWDOWN. Four of yours against the world, and the world blinked.
circuit.squad.castRan: Squad Showdown, Year {year}: your crew {ran}; {champion} took the lanterns home.
circuit.squad.unfunded: {champion} won the Squad Showdown. Your crew stayed home — the trip was never funded.
circuit.squad.uninvited: {champion} won the Squad Showdown. A crew of yours gets the invite the day one of them cracks the world top 64.
circuit.noEntry.reason: {event} ran without anybody from {arcade} in it. {name}: {reason}.
circuit.noEntry.bare: {event} ran without anybody from {arcade} in it — the room has nobody eligible yet.
era.sequel: {oldName} is over. {game} ships today, and every player on earth is a beginner again — including yours. {arcade} has a name that carries; that is the only thing that does.
era.retiredWithIt: {names} {isAre} not starting over. {careerWord} that belonged to {oldName}, and {itThey} with it.
economy.shutdown: The health department shut {arcade} down for {days} days. Nobody let the regulars forget it.
economy.foreclosed: {arcade} was foreclosed on. The last night, nobody wanted to go home.
eureka.temperamentShift: {name} isn't who they were. The room would tell you: they're {row} now.
eureka.veteran.technique: {name} has been sitting on something. It has a name now, and by the weekend everybody in the room is trying it.
eureka.veteran.guide: {name} wrote it all down — everything they know, for anyone who wants it.
eureka.veteran.meta: {name} said something about {game} this week that half the scene is still arguing about. The other half has already changed how they play.
discipline.peaceAfterBan: With {name} gone, a few people who had stopped speaking started again. Whatever that was about, it left with them.
prestige.milestone.repeat: {text} (+{paid} legacy point{s} — this lineage has been here before)
patch.damaged: Patch v{version} did real damage — interest in {game} took a hit the scene may not recover from
patch.recovered: Patch v{version} landed — {game} is back in the conversation
patch.labBuzz: The v{version} meta has everyone in the lab — the room hasn't buzzed like this in months.
succession.mentorship: {mentor} has taken {student} under their wing. Whatever {mentor} knows, {student} is going to know.
succession.prodigy: Some kid has been quietly demolishing people on the corner cabinet all week. Somebody should find out who they are.
succession.poached: {name} stopped coming in. Word is they're travelling with a crew across town now. That one is going to hurt to watch.
succession.noSuccessors: Look around {arcade}: the people who built this place are all near the end of it, and there is nobody standing behind them.
invasion.arrive: {flag} A crew from {region} is in town for {days} day{s} — {names}. Everybody is going to want a set.
invasion.leave.beaten: {flag} {crew} went home — and {beaten} of them left with a worse ranking than they arrived with.
invasion.leave: {flag} {crew} went home. Everybody in the arcade got a story out of it.
worldevent.newFighter: A huge new fighter just launched and it's ALL anyone can talk about. {game} will have to fight for attention for a while.
worldevent.rentHike: The landlord "revisited the market rate." Rent is up 30% for the next three months.
worldevent.powerSurge: A power surge cooked a board mid-session — ${cost} in emergency repairs.
worldevent.viralClip: A clip from the arcade went viral overnight — +{got} followers and the whole scene is suddenly on people's feeds.
worldevent.touringPro: A touring pro dropped in unannounced and ran sets all night. The whole room is buzzing for weeks.
worldevent.pressFeature: A gaming outlet ran a feature on {arcade} — "the last real arcade scene." The comments are surprisingly kind.
team.stormedOut: {name} stormed out of {team} after a falling out
team.betrayal: The day {name} betrayed {team} and walked across the arcade to join {dest}
relevance.goldenAgeEnds: The golden age of {game} has cooled into something quieter. What a stretch it was.
relevance.slumpEnds: {game} has pulled out of its slump — people are coming back.
relevance.goldenAge: A GOLDEN AGE: {game} is the center of the fighting-game world right now.
relevance.slump: {game} has slid into a real slump — the room feels it every night.
relevance.championGoldenAge: A world champion, from THIS arcade. {game} is back in every conversation — a golden age begins.
relevance.phenomenon: {name} has become a national phenomenon — the whole scene is buzzing
relevance.thriving: {name} is thriving again — interest is on the rise
relevance.slipping: {name} is slipping out of the national conversation
relevance.fading: Interest in {name} is fading fast — the golden age is ending
relevance.forgotten: {name} is nearly forgotten. What was once a scene is now a handful of holdouts.
sim.firstTech: {name} discovered the scene's first original tech: "{tech}"
sim.moneyMatch: {winner} beat {loser} {score} in the money match everyone still talks about
sim.mortalEnemies: {a} and {b} became mortal enemies — the arcade quietly picks sides
sim.schoolBack: School went back. {arcade} is going to feel empty for a while.
sim.schoolOut: School is out. {arcade} is about to get busy.
sim.coreAgeing: The core of {arcade} is getting older. {names}{andOthers} aren't quite what they were, and everybody can see it.
stream.stageWin: {who} did it under the lights with {crowd} — you can see it in how they carry themselves now
stream.stageChoke: {who} came apart on stream in front of {crowd}. Something went out of them that night.
tournament.potTaken: {name} came for the {event} pot and took it home. The room watched every game of it.
tournament.banishedWon: {name} — the one you banned — won {event} in your own room and walked out with the pot. Nobody said much after that.
evo.castWon: {champion} WON EVO Year {year}. From this arcade. Nothing will ever top this.
evo.watched: EVO {year} came and went and nobody from {arcade} was in it. {champion} took the title.
